findings.summary: vitest@^2 does not support test.projects (v3-only); only the second project's include glob is picked up, so unit suite src/**/*.test.ts is silently dropped.
findings.suggested_fix: Either bump devDependency vitest to ^3 (planner choice was ^2), OR convert to vitest v2 workspace syntax: top-level test.workspace=['./vitest.unit.config.ts','./vitest.integration.config.ts'] with two sibling files. Verify both labels appear in `pnpm exec vitest list`.

findings.summary: exports points to './src/index.ts' but contracts tsconfig is emitDeclarationOnly; Node ESM (NodeNext) at runtime cannot load .ts, so production `node apps/api/dist/main.js` will fail to resolve @medbridge/contracts.
findings.suggested_fix: Drop emitDeclarationOnly in packages/contracts/tsconfig.json, emit JS to dist/, set exports={'.':{import:'./dist/index.js',types:'./dist/index.d.ts'}}. Production Dockerfile already runs `node` directly, so source-only contracts will break at runtime.

findings.summary: build script `tsc -b && cp -r src/db/migrations dist/db/migrations` will fail in any wave before wave-5 (src/db/migrations does not exist yet).
findings.suggested_fix: Guard the copy: `tsc -b && mkdir -p dist/db && ([ -d src/db/migrations ] && cp -r src/db/migrations dist/db/migrations || true)`. Tighten once wave-5 lands migrations.

findings.summary: No project `references` to packages/contracts even though contracts is composite and apps/api imports it; `tsc -b` from apps/api won't trigger a rebuild of contracts on change.
findings.suggested_fix: Add `"references": [{"path": "../../packages/contracts"}]` to apps/api/tsconfig.json so `tsc -b` rebuilds contracts when its sources change.

findings.summary: Runtime dep @hono/node-server is not enumerated in ARCHITECTURE.md §6.3 allow-list (only `hono` is). Required as the Hono Node adapter but undocumented.
findings.suggested_fix: Add @hono/node-server to docs/ARCHITECTURE.md §6.3 as the Hono Node adapter, or capture in tech-stack ADR. Non-blocking; same risk would apply to any unlisted runtime dep.

findings.summary: On-disk content re-exports './auth.js' which belongs to wave-3 (task-contracts-auth); wave-2's target_files only created an empty barrel. This is post-wave-2 drift, not a wave-2 defect.
findings.suggested_fix: No action for wave-2. Pointer that the file's on-disk content differs from what wave-2 originally committed; wave-3 review owns the auth re-export audit.
